published_review.title: University of Ghana Masters Excellence Scholarship
published_review.issue: Generic all-nationalities full Master's tuition/living support not established by UG financial aid office; its financial aid describes Ghanaian students and fee assistance, not this named Master's programme.

published_review.title: University of Ghana Scholarship
published_review.issue: UG's aid office lists several distinct scholarships and eligibility rules, and fee aid may be full or partial; generic all-nationalities Bachelor's/Master's claim is unsupported.

published_review.title: University of Ghana Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship
published_review.issue: UG financial aid does not establish this generic named universally fully-funded award; no stipend guarantee.

published_review.title: Mastercard Foundation at KNUST
published_review.issue: Official 2025/26 KNUST call requires secondary results, financial need, leadership and non-enrolment in tertiary education; does not establish Master's eligibility or a 2027 deadline.

published_review.title: KNUST Scholarship
published_review.issue: Generic all-nationalities full-tuition claim lacks programme identity; do not equate automatically with Mastercard Foundation at KNUST.

published_review.title: MTN Foundation Scholarship
published_review.issue: Official MTN Nigeria identifies separate Science & Technology, Blind Students and Top 10 UTME scholarships; N300,000 annual awards, not an unrestricted scholarship open to all nationalities.

published_review.title: Tony Elumelu Foundation Entrepreneurship
published_review.issue: Official 2026 programme provides US$5,000 non-refundable seed capital for African entrepreneurs, training and mentorship, NOT tuition, academic degree funding or a Bachelor scholarship. Strong evidence for authenticated audited exclusion from academic scholarship catalog.

published_review.title: United States International University Scholarship
published_review.issue: Generic full-tuition Bachelor award and ALL nationalities lack named programme evidence; separately documented Mastercard Foundation at USIU-Africa covers first-time undergraduate applicants from Africa with strict age, financial and course eligibility.

published_review.title: Strathmore University Scholarship
published_review.issue: Institution homepage alone does not prove universal full tuition or nationality ALL. Find a named award and current call before correcting or publishing.

published_review.title: Rwanda Government Scholarship

published_review.title: University of Rwanda Scholarship

published_review.title: Addis Ababa University Scholarship
published_review.issue: Institution homepage alone does not substantiate a single award across Bachelor/Master/PhD with nationality ALL; needs specific scheme and source.
